reviews.t: This product is simply over priced. Have no idea ...
reviews.x: This product is simply over priced. Have no idea how to use it. Claim to have a video, but the web page cannot be found. Thought the tool was at least a more stronger plastic.this same tool can be found at your local hair store for $.59. Iam returning.

reviews.t: This product does snag, but is a good concept.
reviews.x: This is great in concept. I have Sisterlocks and appreciated that I could use this tool on my very thin locs, but I agree with the other reviewer concerning the snagging. It definitely snags the hair during tightenings. I had to cut the tool in order to get it out of my hair because it became tangled in it. I saw a diagram for a homemade tool which is similar to this one that is made out of guitar strings, so I may try that instead.
There is a point on the inside of the loop that snagged my hair. So the claim of snagless. No it isn't.  However I do enjoy the product, I am just cautious when it comes to that.

I have had dreads for about 6 years.  They are now so long that I have a hard time maintaining them. so I have a natural hair stylist tighten them for me.  Problem was the tool she used was pulling my hair.  I bout this tool as a solution, AND IT WORKED!!.  No snagging, flexible and fast.  She was don in half the time!  She love even placed an order to use on other customers!  The InstaLoc Tool gets an A+!!

reviews.t: This was a great tool for helping with my dreads BUT the item ...
reviews.x: This was a great tool for helping with my dreads BUT the item itself broke after four times using it because it's flimsy plastic. If your locks aren't super tight this item could be used to fix, clean up and interlock your dreads. This is why I gave it 3 stars, I wish the plastic was stronger.

reviews.t: Perhaps more emphasis on the actual size would be wonderful. I cannot even use it
reviews.x: I am rating the actual product's appearance and not the quality itself. I think the product was packed very well and it was pleasing. The reason for the lower rating is due to the size. The item was huge and I was expecting something much smaller that I could use. Perhaps more emphasis  on the actual size would be wonderful. I cannot even use it. 😕

I wouldn't recommend this product for loc maintenance. It is flimsy and seems to be cheaply made. Even though the price is under $5, it still isn't worth it. The instructions provided are not clear, it snags, and the opening is too big.

This is an awesome tool; it makes  the interlocking process  so easy and keeps my hair looking neat all the time. I love that I don't have to pay extra money to maintain my hair .I'm glad that I kept searching until I found this hair tool.

The picture for the product is deceptive because it makes it look like the product is a small plastic need. However, the product is best suited for larger locs. I really don't know how to even use the product to tighten my locs.

reviews.t: Its just a beaded that I could have gotten from ...
reviews.x: Its just a beaded that I could have gotten from a beauty supply for less and it tangled and snagged my locs... will not purchase again
product works well but does snag. I literally had to cut it out of one of my dreads
Wasn't to happy its to flimsy it would be great made of thin medal

This item is soooooo much bigger than I needed to maintain/tighten sisterlocks. I'm looking for something that is bigger than the tool in the beading kit,  which is great for repairing locs, but not THIS big.  I don't recall seeing any length noted in the description on line.  If it was there, I missed it.  What would have helped is a picture of it being used on an actual head so a person would note the tool to head/loc size scale. It's even bigger than I would need to tighten traditional locks.

reviews.t: This is a pretty nifty tool that I find useful for picking dirt ...
reviews.x: This is a pretty nifty tool that I find useful for picking dirt out of my locks, but haven't learned to use it quite like a hook for knitting my loose dreads tight. This is cheap, flimsy plastic and a fair price would $2 for one in my opinion, especially considering shipping cost.

reviews.t: Instructions were unclear, but did not take long to ...
reviews.x: Instructions were unclear, but did not take long to figure it out.  I has been very east to lose, and broke fairly quickly as well.  I would purchase another if you could get two or three for what I paid for one.

Worked very well with my locs. I gently twisted the root theN wove the loc through in to directions. No tension in my scalp and no painful clips. Also good for catching all of the loose hair and new growth.

Love it this tool is great. Very neat package  and delivery. My hair  root  is neat when i use this tool..... have to get another  one for my reserve. Yes it is  not strudy but  i can live with it.........

I thought this would be a sturdy plastic. It is the same as the $1.00 product you purchase at a beauty supply store. Very disappointed and feel cheated.

reviews.t: Too big for fine lock hair.
reviews.x: I thought the item was small but it is too big for my fine lock. It will work better for bigger lock hair.

reviews.t: Nice idea but need different versions for different grades of ...
reviews.x: To thin for thicker dreads. Nice idea but need different versions for different grades of hair.
as they say " u get what you pay for " used it once and it broke
Works great, and the customer service is outstanding. Thanks!

reviews.t: PLASTIC AND CRAPPY, THICK HAIR?? Save your $$$!
reviews.x: I plastic piece of crap. To big, to flemzy. I bought two. First one bent etc. And was trash before my hair was done! Disgusted I went to youtube to learn how to make a tool with a hairpin. Used that instead. Total waste of $$ & very disappointing.

reviews.t: by far the worst dreadlock product I have ever* used on my hair
reviews.x: by far the worst dreadlock product I have ever* used on my hair. My hair got snagged in the "eye" on the little piece of plastic and without any force it broke. I would give this no stars. An absolute waste of money.

claims.text: Several reviewers report the tool snags or tangles hair despite snagless claims, sometimes requiring them to cut it out.
Multiple reviewers find the plastic flimsy and report it breaking or being cheaply made.
Some reviewers say the product is much larger than expected and better suited for larger locs.
Several reviewers complain about unclear instructions or not knowing how to use it.
Some reviewers praise the tool as effective and easy for interlocking and maintaining locs.
